 Order
This Writ Petition has been filed for the issue of writ of mandamus, forbearing the respondents from laying road in the patta lands, belonging to the petitioner.

2.When the matter was came up for hearing on 18.10.2023, this Court has passed the following order:
When the matter was taken up for hearing today, the learned Government Advocate appearing on behalf of the respondents on oral instructions submitted that road has already been laid.
2.When this Writ Petition was entertained on 21.06.2021, this Court had granted an order of interim injunction restraining the respondents from laying the road in the property belonging to the petitioner.
https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis 3.In view of the same, the learned Government Advocate shall take a written instructions from the respondents as to whether the road has been laid and whether the property belonging to the petitioner has been excluded and thereafter, laying of road was completed.
4.Post this case under the caption for orders on 06.11.2023.
3.When the matter was came up for hearing today, the learned Government Advocate appearing on behalf of the respondents 1 to 3 produced the written instructions received from the Block Development Officer.
No costs.
Consequently, connected miscellaneous petition is closed.
